summary: Every REPD technology type the pipeline spine does not carry, one tab each under the REPD's own name. Additive: the solar, BESS and wind product is not read, not rewritten and not refiltered.
modification_note: Adds one launch section above REPD PIPELINE ANALYTICS and its own host node. No spine payload is read, no existing row, filter, count or ranking changes.
section: WIDER FLEET The DESNZ REPD carries 24 technology types. This product's four tabs carry four of them. The other twenty — landfill gas, anaerobic digestion, biomass, EfW incineration, hydro, hydrogen, advanced conversion, tidal, geothermal, compressed and liquid air, flywheels — get the same treatment here: one tab each, under the REPD's own name. Cut from the same REPD extract as the spine. It does not read the spine, bind a project, or emit a news signal. WAIT · register cut not requested at startup
